# Frontend Vendor Assets

## Purpose

- Own bundled third-party JavaScript, CSS, icon, and widget assets used by the settings UI.

## Ownership

- Treat files as vendored dependencies rather than application source.

## Local Contracts

- Avoid local edits unless the task explicitly requires patching the bundled dependency.
- Keep minified and non-minified variants consistent when both are shipped.
